affinity.notes: Warm arcane light accents a primarily neutral stone-and-metal palette.

anatomy.notes: Humanoid construct anatomy and articulated stone armor are structurally convincing.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "durable sentinel with a vulnerable power core" does not semantically communicate Monument-Foundry Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The exposed glowing chest core provides an immediate focal weak-point cue.

finish.notes: Ornament, surface wear, and luminous accents feel cohesive and resolved.

framing.notes: Complete silhouette is centered with adequate breathing room around the halo.

identity.notes: Blind perception "ancient arcane guardian construct" semantically identifies golems/golem-master-golem.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
